title: Bound Multi-Site configuration cardinality and database snapshot materialization

opportunity.rootCause: Multi-Site validation had per-Site limits but no global Site-count limit, while startup/runtime database loaders materialized every waf_sites row without a bound.
opportunity.scope: SiteConfigurationValidator, SiteDatabaseStore snapshot reads, startup snapshot loading, and the default Waf:Sites configuration

implementation: Added configurable Waf:Sites:MaxSites with a default of 10000 and a hard configuration ceiling of 100000.
Rejected oversized configuration and typed database snapshots before runtime route activation.
Bounded ListAsync and bootstrap TryLoadSnapshot with LIMIT max+1 and fail-closed InvalidDataException when the database contains more Sites than allowed.
Made the bounded summary read reject an invalid database total instead of silently presenting a partial operational state.

tddRed.reason: The new cardinality tests initially failed because configuration/snapshot validation had no global Site limit and database loading had no MaxSites/LIMIT contract.

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL oversized-table execution and query-plan/latency benchmark
Concurrent multi-instance activation against an oversized or changing database
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
